clue.text: Consider carefully how to be a shoplifter

definitions.meaning: to weigh up a situation before acting
read literally, a shoplifter walks off with goods from the shelves

explanation.surface: A whimsical question about how one might go about shoplifting.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means pause and review; taken literally it means helping yourself to a shop's merchandise.

clue.text: A Roman law is for him

parts.note: lex is the Latin word for law

explanation.surface: Someone remarks that a certain Roman law exists for a particular man's benefit.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'him': the answer is a man's name, and 'for' links it to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A boy's given name stands for a male person, referred to as him.

clue.text: Standard term for a US naval officer

definitions.meaning: a flag or banner carried as an emblem

definitions.text: term for a US naval officer
definitions.meaning: the lowest commissioned rank in the American navy

explanation.surface: A question of terminology: the standard title for a junior officer in the American navy.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a flag flown at sea and a junior commissioned officer's rank.

clue.text: The aim is to acquire bitumen first

indicators.note: first says the bitumen piece comes ahead of the acquiring piece

parts.note: bitumen is a kind of tar
to acquire is to get

explanation.surface: A road-builder's goal: to obtain bitumen before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: An aim is a goal one shoots for, an object of ambition.

clue.text: Salvationists interrupt vulgar campaign

indicators.note: to interrupt is to break into the middle, so the Salvationists sit inside the other word

parts.note: vulgar means crude
SA is the Salvation Army, whose members are Salvationists

explanation.surface: Salvation Army members break in on a coarse political campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: A crusade is a vigorous campaign for a cause, from the medieval holy wars.

clue.text: Potter creates chaos all round

parts.note: chaos is a mess
about can mean all round, as in scattered about

explanation.surface: A potter at the wheel makes a mess everywhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Potter' looks like a noun, a craftsman with clay, but it is the verb: to potter is to idle aimlessly.
explanation.definitionFit: To potter is to fiddle about doing nothing much, which is to fool around idly.

clue.text: Braid does need to be positioned by a dresser

indicators.note: the letters of the two words must be placed in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Instructions for where a braid should be placed beside a dressing table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'need to be positioned' rearranges BRAIDDOES; 'by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A dresser is a piece of furniture with shelves and drawers, much like a buffet cabinet.

clue.text: Council leader put one day in here

indicators.note: in means the one-and-day pair goes inside the word for here

parts.note: to be here is to be present
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone schedules a council leader's visit on a particular day.
explanation.definitionFit: The chairman of a council or society is often titled its president.

clue.text: Superior Spanish male has taken one in

indicators.note: the Spanish word has taken something into itself
in confirms the extra piece goes inside the Spanish word

parts.note: señor is Spanish for a man or Mr
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A Spanish gentleman takes someone in.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior person ranks above others, so is their superior.

clue.text: Be sufficiently competent to take dimensions

definitions.meaning: to be good enough for a task
to find the size of something with a tape or rule

explanation.surface: Being competent enough to take a set of measurements.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means reach the required standard; literally it means gauge the size of something.

clue.text: Put a value on some lasses' sapphires

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An appraiser values some girls' sapphire jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition 'Put a value' left 'on' as a link, but the verb needs 'on' to swap for the answer: 'put a value on' the gems means value them.
explanation.definitionFit: To evaluate something is to judge its worth, as an appraiser does.

clue.text: Adam was a bachelor

parts.note: Adam was literally the only man in the world at first, and before Eve came along he was unmarried too

explanation.surface: A remark about Adam's marital status before Eve appeared.
explanation.definitionFit: An unmarried male is a bachelor; Adam was also the one and only man in existence.

clue.text: Not a main route out of the country

parts.note: in British road classes the main routes are A roads, so a road that is not A is a B road
a main route is a road

explanation.surface: Someone says this is not a major road leading out of the country.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain main roads are A roads and lesser ones B roads, so 'Not a main route' hints at a B road; 'a' adds the A.
explanation.definitionFit: Being overseas means away from one's homeland, in foreign parts.

clue.text: The woman will support an ancient mariner

parts.note: she'll is short for she will
to support is to back

explanation.surface: A woman promises to help an old sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: A shellback is slang for a veteran seaman, especially one who has crossed the equator.

clue.text: Demand to ban Sunday opening is a near miss

parts.note: to ban opening on a Sunday is to close
a demand is a call

explanation.surface: Campaigners narrowly fail to stop shops opening on Sundays.
explanation.definitionFit: A narrow escape from disaster is a close shave or near thing.

clue.text: Escort agency is brought to account

indicators.note: is brought to says the agency follows on after the account abbreviation

parts.note: an agency is a company

explanation.surface: An escort agency is held to account.
explanation.definitionFit: To escort someone is to go along with them as a companion.

clue.text: Understand it's within a bishop's jurisdiction

definitions.meaning: to grasp, as in I get it
a diocese, the area a bishop oversees

explanation.surface: A remark that something falls within a bishop's authority.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means grasp; the noun is a diocese or the throne of a bishop.

clue.text: Pen acquired within the past year

indicators.note: within says the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Someone bought a pen during the last year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pen' looks like a writing instrument but is an enclosure for pigs.
explanation.definitionFit: A sty is an enclosure for pigs, a kind of pen.

clue.text: Directions by a lady

indicators.note: by means the next piece is placed beside the directions

parts.note: E and N are the compass directions east and north

explanation.surface: Directions given by a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ena is a woman's name, so stands for a lady.

clue.text: Drunk gets only 50% commission

parts.note: fifty per cent is half
a commission is a cut or share of the takings

explanation.surface: A drunk complains of receiving only half the usual commission.
explanation.walkthrough: HALF-CUT is British slang for tipsy.
explanation.definitionFit: Being half-cut is British slang for being tipsy or intoxicated.

clue.text: Particle lodged a short time in nerve-cell

indicators.note: lodged says something becomes stuck within something else
in names the nerve cell as the container

parts.note: a neuron is a nerve cell
T is short for time

explanation.surface: A particle briefly becomes lodged in a nerve cell.
explanation.definitionFit: A neutron is an uncharged subatomic particle found in atomic nuclei.

clue.text: Some of them coped very easily indeed

indicators.note: some of says only part of the words is used, a run sitting within them

explanation.surface: A remark that some of them managed with great ease indeed.
explanation.definitionFit: Yea is an old word for yes, used for emphasis like truly.

clue.text: Delight in French plainsong

parts.note: en is French for in
plainsong is a form of chant

explanation.surface: Someone takes delight in French plainsong.
explanation.definitionFit: To delight someone is to charm or captivate them.

clue.text: Reading from Bible means fewer commitments

definitions.meaning: a passage of scripture read aloud in church
... one's plate, with fewer things on

explanation.surface: A Bible reading suggests a lighter schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: A church reading is called this; split as two words it means having less on.

clue.text: Parisian palace found in a Cambridgeshire diocese

parts.note: Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire
a see is a bishop's diocese

explanation.surface: A French palace is unexpectedly located in an English diocese.
explanation.walkthrough: Ely is a small cathedral city in the English county of Cambridgeshire.
explanation.definitionFit: The Élysée is the palace in Paris where the French president lives.

clue.text: and goodness to the vile seem vile." (King Lear, Act IV)

definitions.text: and goodness to the vile seem vile

parts.words: and goodness to the vile seem vile
parts.note: the first word of this line from Albany's speech in King Lear is missing, and the solver supplies it

explanation.surface: A line from King Lear with its opening word left out.
explanation.definitionFit: The quotation's missing first word is the quality of sound judgement, paired here with goodness.

clue.text: About to change course and yield

parts.note: re means about or concerning
to change course is to turn

explanation.surface: Someone is about to change direction and give way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yield' looks like the verb give way, but it is the noun: profit on an investment.
explanation.definitionFit: A yield is the profit or income gained from an investment.

clue.text: Airman demanded to be publicly applauded

parts.note: AC is aircraftman, the lowest RAF rank
to demand is to claim

explanation.surface: An airman insisted on public applause.
explanation.definitionFit: Being acclaimed means being praised enthusiastically in public.

clue.text: Purchase fungi we hear, to create muscle

indicators.note: we hear says the words are judged by how they are spoken

parts.note: purchase is buy and ceps are a kind of mushroom

explanation.surface: Someone buys mushrooms in the hope of building muscle.
explanation.definitionFit: The biceps is the large muscle at the front of the upper arm.

clue.text: Was unconscious of having left Sandhurst!

definitions.meaning: Sandhurst is the British Army officer academy, and its cadets graduate at a parade

explanation.surface: A cadet was out cold on graduating from military college.
explanation.walkthrough: Sandhurst is the British Army's officer training academy; cadets finishing there are said to pass out.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means faint, and also complete training at a military academy.

clue.text: A lot of settlers from Colorado and New York

parts.note: Colo is an abbreviation for Colorado

explanation.surface: A group of settlers arrives from two American states.
explanation.definitionFit: A colony is a group of people who settle together in a new land.

clue.text: Classing new emigrants

indicators.note: new means the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Newly arrived emigrants are sorted into categories.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Classing' is the definition: in schools, streaming puts pupils into classes by ability.
explanation.definitionFit: Streaming groups schoolchildren by ability, sorting them into sets.
